tasks.label: Build and test Nautilus extension
args: set -e; zig_bin="$(command -v zig || find "$HOME/.config/Code/User/globalStorage/ziglang.vscode-zig/zig" -type f -name zig -perm -111 -print -quit)"; test -n "$zig_bin" || { echo 'Zig compiler not found in PATH or VS Code Zig extension storage' >&2; exit 1; }; "$zig_bin" build; sudo ln -sfn "$PWD/zig-out/lib/libnautilus_ovpn.so" /usr/lib64/nautilus/extensions-4/libnautilus_ovpn.so; if pgrep -x nautilus >/dev/null; then nautilus -q; fi; mkdir -p /tmp/nautilus-ovpn-extension-test; nautilus --new-window /tmp/nautilus-ovpn-extension-test
